metadata.clock: Sum of wall-clock elapsed milliseconds spent synchronously inside actual adapter.replace(records) over the trace. Excludes scroll dispatch, dataset initialization, slicing, correctness checks and paint. Fresh full Chromium process for each arm visit, rotating order.

reproduction.instructions: From the Saba checkout, save driverSource as scroll-overlap.cjs beside the previous grid bundle saved as previous.js and its matching previous-manifest.json. Rebuild the current grid with the pinned dependencies as for bench:scale. Set PLAYWRIGHT_PATH if needed and run node /path/to/scroll-overlap.cjs 9 /path/to/result.json. The driver verifies source and bundle hashes and runs the real window controller.
